learning_order:
**1-10:** Buy everything: Serpent Sting, Arcane Shot, Hunter's Mark, Concussive Shot, Aspect of the Monkey, Parry. Track Beasts/Humanoids are cheap.
**10:** Most important level (pet quest + Aspect of the Hawk). Train Growl, Great Stamina, Natural Armor for the pet right away.
**12-20:** Mend Pet, Wing Clip rank 1, Multi-Shot (18), new Serpent Sting/Arcane Shot/Hawk ranks. Skip Eagle Eye, Eyes of the Beast, Scare Beast, Track Undead, Distracting Shot.
Ranged specs (BM/MM) can skip Raptor Strike ranks and Mongoose Bite; Survival buys them (plus Immolation Trap, Dual Wield).
**20:** Aimed Shot (now baseline), Aspect of the Cheetah, Freezing Trap, Mend Pet 2. Skip pet resistances and Disengage unless grouping.
**22-30:** Hunter's Mark 2, Rapid Fire (26), Frost Trap (28), Feign Death (30), Aimed/Arcane/Hawk/Sting ranks. Skip Scorpid Sting (optional), Beast Lore, Track Hidden/Elementals.
**30-40:** Growl ranks for the pet, Explosive Trap optional for AoE pulls. Skip Flare, Track Demons/Giants, Viper Sting, Wing Clip 2.
Save gold for the level 40 mount; Mail at 40 is a must, Aspect of the Pack and Volley are optional.
**40-60:** Keep Aimed Shot, Serpent Sting, Hawk, Mend Pet, Hunter's Mark and Growl current. Skip Aspect of the Wild, Track Dragonkin, Freezing Trap 2/3 if short on gold.
**Talent ranks** (Summon Hawk, Trueshot Aura, Sniper Shot, Counterattack) only show up if you took the talent; buy them when they do.
Arcane Shot ranks 4+ are low priority (Method: weak after ~25; BM's Summon Hawk shares its cooldown).
Money: Skinning (+ Leatherworking or Mining) is the usual hunter money pair; buy cheap food in bulk.
disagreements: Arcane Shot: Method calls it near redundant after 25 (except long fights); Warcraft Tavern Forever still lists it in every rotation.
Raptor Strike: Method says it loses almost all value after 10 (kite instead); Warcraft Tavern Forever uses it in melee range and for Survival.
Multi-Shot (Classic forum): one poster says skip while leveling, others call it a top damage ability; Forever guides treat it as core AoE.
Scorpid Sting: Warcraft Tavern Classic says skip; a Classic forum poster says train it. Forever changed it to -2% hit chance.
Tracking: Classic guides skip most tracking; in Forever Survival's Improved Tracking adds damage vs the tracked type, so Survival may want them.
forever_differences: Aimed Shot is baseline at 20 (no talent) and shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot; Arcane Shot no longer does (Blizzard deep dive).
Improved Hunter's Mark and Improved Eyes of the Beast are baseline (Blizzard deep dive).
Traps usable in combat on a 30s cooldown; fire and frost traps have separate cooldowns (Blizzard deep dive).
Aspect of the Beast now grants melee attack power (melee Survival aspect) (Blizzard deep dive).
Scorpid Sting now reduces target hit chance by 2% instead of Str/Agi (Blizzard deep dive, Warcraft Tavern).

New talent abilities with trainer ranks: Summon Hawk (BM, shares cooldown with Arcane Shot), Sniper Shot (MM), Trueshot Aura moved to a 21-point talent with lower ranks, Counterattack 16-point talent (Blizzard deep dive).
Disengage threat reduction doubled; pets scale from hunter gear and no longer take player stat buffs (Blizzard deep dive).
Improved Tracking (Survival) increases damage vs the creature type you track (Blizzard deep dive, Warcraft Tavern).
open_questions: Multi-Shot appears only once (no ranks) in the Forever trainer list; whether it scales with level was not confirmed by a guide.
Icy Veins and Mobalytics Forever hunter guides returned 403 and could not be read.
No source covers whether pet resistance training (Arcane/Fire/Frost/Nature/Shadow Resistance) matters in Forever dungeons.
